policy.rule: A claim may not be broader than its recorded adversary view. Conditional and pending claims are not headline claims.

claims.statement: The named frozen forward-frame probes did not exceed their matched majority control in the recorded latent-native v5 configuration.
claims.adversary_view: Post-training released forward frames only; excludes training gradients, remote state, optimizer state, timing, and cross-step history.
claims.configuration: latent-native v5, split_after=14, latent_dim=64, 48 chaff rows, rotation and token permutation, 10,000 steps.
claims.statistical_unit: Token row; historical dependence audit identifies block-level clustering.
claims.positive_control: Historical naked/defended bundles exist, but are not representation-matched complete-view controls.

provenance.corpus_split: 256 train and 256 evaluation blocks; exact corpus bytes identified in corpus_manifest_original.json

limitations: One seed is not a headline confirmation set.
Forward-only success is not privacy evidence without matched positive controls.

claims.statement: The historical gradient-channel audit found recovery above its matched control and exact real/chaff support disclosure.

claims.configuration: latent-native v5, split_after=14, latent_dim=64, 48 chaff rows, 10,000 steps.
claims.statistical_unit: Token row, with frame-level dependence requiring clustered analysis.
